title: Codex reviewer structured output envelope
description: Documents the shape scripts.marketplace_ci.review.validate_review_output actually enforces (the Python function is authoritative; this file is documentation, not a separately-run validator). This is a single reviewer's own envelope -- the exact shape codex-review-bridge's bridge-invoke.mjs returns per dispatch_reviewers() call (see codex-review-bridge/references/envelope-schema.md), not a whole-run coverage summary. run-codex-review assembles the whole-run mode/reviewed_paths/reviewers payload itself, from ReviewScope and the ReviewerReport list -- not from this envelope.

provenance.description: Not deeply validated by validate_review_output beyond presence -- see codex-review-bridge/references/envelope-schema.md for its full field list.

axis.description: The reviewer's own finding identifier (e.g. a plugin-rulebook rule ID) or a short category slug.

location.description: A path, optionally suffixed with ":line" or ":line:col" -- validate_review_output splits the line number off before building its own Finding.path/Finding.line.

components.description: Optional secondary citations for a multi-file finding. Not consumed by validate_review_output -- validated JS-side by bridge-invoke.mjs's semanticallyValidate before this envelope is ever returned.
